title: Final decision on bike taxis after discussion with Advocate General: Karnataka transport minister Byrathi Suresh
summary: Reacting to the Supreme Court order, Suresh said the government would have to comply with the court's directions but was considering framing regulations and imposing restrictions rather than imposing a blanket ban on bike taxis.
llm_summary: Karnataka’s transport minister Byrathi Suresh said the state will obey the Supreme Court’s order on bike‑taxis but isn’t ready to enforce a total ban. Instead, the government plans to draft a regulatory framework that could impose specific restrictions and guidelines for the service. This approach aims to balance legal compliance with the need for a workable, tech‑enabled mobility solution.
